put.summary: Set typed DL24M target while OFF
put.description: Only modifies the selected bank, with journaled original target and readback. Activation uses mode-specific predictions plus measured V/I/P guards: CR at configured maximum voltage, CP at fresh cutoff voltage, CV requires fresh device OCP/OPP no greater than local limits. CV cannot promise a current ceiling from its voltage target alone.

cutoff_voltage_v.description: Instrument low-voltage cutoff in V; DL24M supports 0.1 V steps.

time_limit_s.description: Instrument timer in seconds, zero disables it. DL24M requires multiples of 60; this is not the bridge-local activation deadline.

working_brightness.description: Active display brightness level 0..9 (numeric level, not a percentage).

current_resolution.description: Instrument current display/resolution enum 0..2; no cross-device numeric precision is implied.

overvoltage_v.description: Instrument overvoltage protection threshold in V; conservative supported range 3..25 V.

overcurrent_a.description: Instrument overcurrent protection threshold in A; conservative supported range 0.05..2.5 A.

overpower_w.description: Instrument overpower protection threshold in W; conservative supported range 1..15 W. Wire write/read scales differ and are handled by the driver.

overtemperature_c.description: Internal instrument overtemperature protection threshold in degrees Celsius.

fan_temperature_c.description: Instrument fan start threshold in degrees Celsius.

battery_overtemperature_c.description: Instrument battery-probe overtemperature threshold in degrees Celsius (command 0x50, read 0x3C). It is not a PID gain or a substitute for the bridge cell guard.

language.description: Raw instrument language enum 0 or 1. The driver handles temporary menu entry and exit.

mode.description: Native selected mode: 0 CC, 1 CV, 2 CR, 3 CP. Prefer setDl24mMode and setDl24mTarget for typed changes with a fresh OFF/mode/target snapshot and checked restoration. Activation independently validates fresh mode-specific current, voltage and power limits; consult Device.features for commissioning status.

standby_time.description: Raw standby-time value 0..120; its physical time unit is not yet confirmed. Do not interpret it as seconds.

Dl24mSettings.description: Partial update or cached snapshot of supported DL24M settings in engineering units, except explicitly raw enums/time. Current integration is commissioned on display firmware Ver: 2.0. Conservative schema maxima are bridge support limits, not claimed instrument ratings.

name.description: Stable driver register label; see the protocol handbook for command/scaling.

command.description: Read command byte as a decimal integer (for example 17 means 0x11).

quality.description: valid: usable within freshness policy; stale: previous sample is too old; unavailable: no usable sample. Never substitute zero for invalid/missing data.

value.description: Unsigned 24-bit raw register payload; omitted until usable data is available.

age_ms.description: Elapsed milliseconds since receipt, evaluated for this response. A repeated read does not freshen a cached sample.

received_ms.description: Node-monotonic milliseconds when this sample was received. Compare only within the same node and boot_id.

Dl24mRegister.description: One audited passive DL24M numeric read. Values are unsigned 24-bit raw payloads; meaning and scaling depend on command. Missing values indicate unavailable data, not zero.

registers.description: The audited passive register set, each carrying its own quality and age.

Dl24mRegisters.description: Cached view of the 22 audited passive reads. No arbitrary read/write access or side-effecting menu/calibration commands are exposed.

bank.description: Inactive target bank 1, 2 or 3. Bank 0 is the active CC bank and is not selected through this interface.

Dl24mBankRequest.description: Inactive bank selection for a temporary, OFF-only mode-switch transaction that restores CC afterwards.

bank.description: Inactive bank 1 CV, 2 CR or 3 CP. This legacy raw interface always returns to CC; prefer typed mode/target operations for normal control.

target_raw.description: OFF-only raw target. Additional bank-dependent maxima: 1=1000, 2=2400, 3=100. Successful completion returns to CC and restores its original target.

Dl24mBankTargetRequest.description: Inactive bank target in raw register units. This interface does not claim that the corresponding active CV/CR/CP behavior or scales are commissioned.

Dl24mTraceEntry.description: One actual BLE transport byte chunk. Receive chunks can contain partial or multiple frames; do not reinterpret as HID.

hex.description: Hexadecimal bytes, at most 64 per entry.

truncated.description: Oversized chunk truncated to preserve memory bounds.

origin.description: ble-stack records accepted BLE GATT submissions and actual notifications; tx does not imply ATT/application success. endpoint is a non-radio test/fallback observation.

Dl24mDiagnostics.description: Passive bounded diagnostics, independent of driver parsing.

Dl24mModeRequest.description: Select a native mode without enabling output or modifying that bank target. Confirmed OFF, live original mode/target snapshot, persistent rollback and checked readback required.

mode.description: Native DL24M BLE mapping: CC=0, CV=1, CR=2, CP=3. HID scaling is not used.

Dl24mTargetRequest.description: Set the selected mode target while OFF. Mode and unit must agree. CC 0.001 A; CV 0.01 V; CR 0.1 Ohm; CP 0.1 W. Configured local limits and activation prerequisites still apply.

mode.description: Expected selected mode; mismatches reject without writes.

unit.description: A for CC, V for CV, Ohm for CR, W for CP.
